consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the Dane County Coliseum on February 3, 1978, highlighting the energy and quality of the second set, particularly the Estimated>Eyes and Music Never Stopped. Many reviewers note that this show stands out as one of the best of the year, showcasing Jerry Garcia's exceptional guitar work and the band's tight cohesion.
